name: Hospitality, Travel & Aviation Operations Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Hospitality, Travel, and Aviation, covering Central Reservation Systems (CRS), GDS (Global Distribution System) integration, hotel check-in / room assignment, flight availability search, e-ticketing, baggage tracking, crew scheduling, and flight disruption management.

checklists.name: Hospitality, Travel & Aviation Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for hotel PMS reservations, GDS e-ticketing, baggage tracking, and flight disruption handling.

items.statement: Central Reservation System (CRS) synchronizes room/seat inventory across distribution channels without overbooking.
Passenger Name Records (PNR) capture mandatory passenger contact info and passport details.
Hotel guest check-in pre-authorizes credit cards for room charges and incidental deposits.
Baggage handling system scans IATA barcode tags at airport checkpoints to prevent lost luggage.
Irregular Operations (IROP) flight cancellations automatically trigger passenger rebooking and hotel/meal voucher generation.

reviewGates.name: Travel & Aviation Operations Director Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Director of Travel & Aviation Operations confirms that GDS ticketing, PMS check-in, and flight operations satisfy industry standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the travel & aviation documentation confirm reservation accuracy and flight operations compliance?
